title: Context note
description: One note under `.ai/context/`: domain knowledge, terminology, or an environment description. Named rather than numbered, because a note is referred to by what it is about. `.ai/context/stack.md` written by `init` is a context note, and its `CTX-stack` id follows the same rule as every other one.

source.description: Where the facts came from: a document, an observed command output, or a person's statement. An unsourced note is a rumour with a filename.
